decisions.decision: Build and ship it end to end now. 1) In cloud/src/index.ts, next to the Zoom routes near line 620, add an admin-only POST /admin/api/zoom/forget taking {meeting_id, confirm}. Refuse unless confirm equals meeting_id and Zoom's GET /meetings/{id} returns code 3001. If those pass, run one D1 batch that deletes the meeting's rows from zoom_meetings, zoom_events, zoom_attendance, zoom_recordings, zoom_chat, zoom_polls and zoom_engagement, delete its R2 transcript, and log a centre_events row with the counts. 2) In cloud/admin-ui/admin.js, add a 'Forget this meeting' button with a type-the-id prompt. 3) Add the cases to probe-zoom-pro.mjs: refuses a meeting that still exists, refuses a wrong confirmation, deletes a 3001 meeting. Run it against vendor-sim plus wrangler dev. 4) Commit to main, wrangler deploy, run it on 89781893618 in production, then run tracker_sync.py and check that both Tracker tabs and the admin panel no longer show it. Don't use 87002851906 to test the refusal.
decisions.why: This is all our own Worker and D1, and the target is a test meeting that was deleted in Zoom (LOG 2026-10-07 23:21; T-245 log 2026-10-08). orchestrator-autonomy authorises deploys and changes to our own data. Nothing here needs Adi.
